The HWPX intake summary automation achieved full success with a 1.0 verifier reward, confirming the reliability of the current LangChain graph implementation.
The execution passed all tests in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with zero exceptions and a mean reward of 1.000. Results were successfully serialized to result.json after a 3m 54s runtime. While the judge_reward of 0.78 suggests minor stylistic or efficiency optimizations remain, the core logic for HWPX document processing is now verified as functional.
